caption: The drawing depicts a tall wooden chest of drawers, also known as a highboy, consisting of an upper section with four large horizontal drawers stacked vertically and a lower section with three smaller drawers and a central arched compartment. The furniture stands on four long, slender, cabriole legs. The entire chest is adorned with ornate decorative patterns and motifs, rendered in a palette dominated by dark brown and reddish-brown wood tones, with accents of gold and muted greens. The decorative elements on the drawer fronts include scenes or patterns that appear to be inspired by nature or classical themes. The hardware, such as handles and keyholes, is depicted in gold or brass color, contrasting with the darker wood. The background is plain and off-white, leaving the chest as the main focus of the drawing.
title: Highboy
